sn46.19:1.1: “Bhikkhus, these seven factors of enlightenment, when developed and cultivated, are noble and emancipating; they lead the one who acts upon them out to the complete destruction of suffering.
sn46.19:1.3: The enlightenment factor of mindfulness … the enlightenment factor of equanimity.
sn46.19:1.4: These seven factors of enlightenment … lead the one who acts upon them out to the complete destruction of suffering.”
